definitions.explanation: A state of heightened energy, excitement, or enthusiasm in a group or at an event. Describes the atmosphere when people are energized and engaged.
A physical bump, swell, or raised area on a surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごかった→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧。
examples.english: The excitement at the venue was incredible.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高潮|さいこうちょう}→最高潮：19278_saikouchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The excitement at the live concert reached its peak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
examples.english: In the excitement of the final stretch of the match, the entire audience rose to their feet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a bump in the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the swell of the muscles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}った→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I touched it before the paint dried, so a bump formed on the surface.

notes:
USAGE:
The nominal form of the verb ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧ (to get excited, to swell). Sense 1 (excitement/enthusiasm) is by far the more common usage. Often describes the atmosphere at events, parties, concerts, and sporting matches. The phrase {盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ (to lack excitement) is used for disappointingly flat events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack excitement
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show excitement/enthusiasm
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{上|あ}がり: the greatest excitement
